tool_input.description: Build and load shop images in test cluster

result:
Planning for chapter 012 is done. I ran the pre-check in the temporary container `k8s-lab-ingress012-961878` and deleted it afterwards; `k8s-lab.sh ls` shows nothing left. I didn't touch `k8s-lab`, `deep_vision_5090_vllm` or chapters 001–011.

**Controller chosen: Traefik v3.7.13**, installed from a pinned static manifest with no Helm needed.
- **Why not ingress-nginx:** it was archived on 24 Mar 2026 and gets no more security patches. Its last version, v1.15.1, supports Kubernetes only up to 1.35, but the students' cluster is v1.37.
- **Why Traefik:** it's still maintained (v3.7.13 came out 4 Sep 2026), and the image pulls directly. It handles standard Ingress, IngressClass and TLS. It can also run Gateway API and basic auth that reads the `kubernetes.io/basic-auth` Secret from chapter 011.
- **Ports:** HTTP on 30080, HTTPS on 30081, Traefik dashboard on 30082.
- **Port clash:** if the chapter 011 shop still holds 30080, installing Traefik fails with `provided port is already allocated`. LAB 0 has students delete the old shop Services first, but keeps the database and orders.
- **Settings Traefik needs to match the Kubernetes standard** (all three are already in the manifest):
  - `strictPrefixMatching=true`. Without it, Prefix `/api` also matches `/apix`.
  - `allowEmptyServices=true`. Without it, a Service with no ready Pods gives 404 instead of 503.
  - `websecure.http.tls=true`. Without it, `https://` returns 404 even though the certificate loads.

**Pre-check results**
- **`*.localhost` names:** Chromium 153 and curl 8.5 both go to 127.0.0.1 without editing the hosts file. The system resolver does not (`getent` fails, and Node/Python can't find the name). Fallbacks that work: `curl -H 'Host: …'`, `curl --resolve`, or editing hosts.
- **Full browser test:** `http://shop.localhost:30080` → 301 → `https://shop.localhost:30081` → shop page loads. The admin page gives 401 without login and 200 with it. I simulated the students' ports so the test never reached the learner's container.
- **Images:** `traefik:v3.7.13` (7.4 s), whoami and nginx-unprivileged all pull straight from Docker Hub with no `kind load`. postgres still needs pull, save, then `kind load image-archive`, and the shop images are built and loaded as before. The Traefik CRDs must go in before the controller, or its log fills with `Failed to watch`.
- **Rolling update through Ingress:** with readiness checks and a short pre-shutdown pause, err=0 every time. Without them, I saw some 502 errors (3–6 in 300 requests).
- **Gateway API add-on:** works; a 90/10 traffic split gave 36 : 4 over 40 requests.

**Images: 53 theory + 31 LAB = 84, of which 47 are marked `needs_test`.** A script confirmed the JSON parses, paths are unique, and every prompt has 1–7 labels with at least one Thai label. Labels are numbered, so test-dependent values like ports appear only in Text.

**LABs**
- **LAB 0:** free the ports and load the images.
- **LAB 1:** install Traefik and IngressClass.
- **LAB 2:** first Ingress, one host name.
- **LAB 3:** route by path (`/`, `/api`, `/admin` to three Services).
- **LAB 4:** route by host name.
- **LAB 5:** pathType.
- **LAB 6:** debugging 404, 503 and defaultBackend.
- **LAB 7:** TLS.
- **LAB 8:** Traefik-only features: redirect, basic auth, prefix stripping.
- **LAB 9:** rolling update through Ingress.
- **LAB 10 (final, `som-shop-v8`):** shop becomes ClusterIP, the old HTTPS NodePort is removed, and a new `som-tls` covers shop.localhost and admin.localhost. Admin is protected by basic auth, HTTP redirects to HTTPS, and the 1.5 → 1.6 update ran with err=0.
- **Extra LAB:** Gateway API.

**Still to confirm when writing the real LABs**
- Browsers on the students' machines: Edge, Firefox, Safari, and Docker Desktop on Windows/macOS. Only Chromium on Linux was tested.
- What redirect address you get if the port setting is left out (expected `:443`, not tested yet).
- `hit.sh` needs changing to work with HTTPS; not written yet.
- The pre-check used namespace `demo`, but the LABs will use `ingress-demo`. Re-run everything under that name.
- The number of 502 errors without preStop varies by machine, and the order count depends on what's left from chapter 011. The images don't hard-code either.
- The 36 : 4 result is random each run; it may be better shown as ≈ 90 : 10.

Files are in `logs/012_ingress/`:
- plan.md
- images.json
- build_images.py
- imgcommon.py
- precheck/ (the tested manifests, to start from when writing the LABs)

The two imagegen-prompts.md files are in `012_kubernetes_ingress/01_Theory/images/` and `012_kubernetes_ingress/02_LAB/images/`.

Sources: [Kubernetes blog: Ingress NGINX Retirement](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2025/11/11/ingress-nginx-retirement/), [Steering/SRC statement](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/01/29/ingress-nginx-statement/), [kubernetes/ingress-nginx](https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx), [Before You Migrate](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/02/27/ingress-nginx-before-you-migrate/), [Ingress2Gateway 1.0](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/03/20/ingress2gateway-1-0-release/), [Traefik releases](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/releases), [Traefik Kubernetes Ingress docs](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/reference/install-configuration/providers/kubernetes/kubernetes-ingress/), [Traefik Gateway API docs](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/reference/install-configuration/providers/kubernetes/kubernetes-gateway/)
